guide.inShort: The Platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Treat it as a checklist audit, not a task of its own.

steps.text: Work through the roadmap stages in order so story, collectible and activity trophies are never left stranded.
Use the Ledger counters to close every count-based trophy before starting a final completion sweep.
When only this trophy remains, sync your trophies and let the Platinum pop on the summary screen.

guide.inShort: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It teaches movement, driving and the partner switch, and it cannot be skipped.

steps.text: Start a new game and follow the opening prompts through the fishing trip sequence.
Complete every objective marker until the mission complete banner appears.
The trophy pops during the hand-off into free roam, so do not quit mid-cutscene.

guide.inShort: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Simply follow the main markers; chapter trophies are unmissable on a normal playthrough.

steps.text: Clear every main-story marker tagged for Chapter 1 in the pause menu journal.
Keep both protagonists stocked with snacks and armour before the chapter finale.
Watch the closing cutscene to the end so the chapter registers as complete.

guide.inShort: Finish Chapter 2. The chapter leans into the Leonida Keys, so learn boat handling early and the finale becomes routine.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 2 story markers and finish each set-piece in order.
Practise switching characters during chases, because Chapter 2 tests it under pressure.
Complete the chapter finale and stay through the results screen.

guide.inShort: Finish Chapter 3, the Vice City chapter. Expect denser traffic and police pressure than the rural chapters.

steps.text: Work the Chapter 3 markers across Vice City, using alleyways to break line of sight.
Upgrade one reliable getaway car before the mid-chapter heist sequence.
Finish the finale and let the chapter card play out for the pop.

guide.inShort: Finish Chapter 4. Difficulty steps up here, so go in with full health, armour and a stocked weapon wheel.

steps.text: Clear the Chapter 4 story chain, saving side activities for after the chapter closes.
Restock at Ammu-Nation between missions rather than mid-mission.
Beat the chapter finale and remain in game until the trophy notification appears.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

guide.inShort: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save just before the point of no return so any ending-linked cleanup stays reachable.

steps.text: Make a separate manual save before starting the final mission chain.
Enter the finale with max armour, snacks and your best weapons for both characters.
Complete the mission and watch through the credits roll for the Gold to register.

guide.inShort: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a short early errand mission, so treat it as driving practice.

steps.text: Pick up the Breakfast Run marker when it appears on the story path.
Drive the route cleanly and avoid picking up a wanted level on the way back.
Hand in the final objective and wait for the mission passed screen.

guide.inShort: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Choose the quiet approach on a first run; it leaves more margin for error.

steps.text: Complete the setup objectives for The Cartel Heist as they unlock in the journal.
During the escape, switch drivers early and stick to side streets to shed heat.
Reach the drop-off and stay for the payout cutscene to close the mission.

guide.inShort: Finish the story mission Child's Play. A character-driven mission with light combat, so keep it simple and follow the markers.

steps.text: Start Child's Play from the story marker and follow the family errand objectives.
Use cover during the short shootout instead of pushing through the middle.
Finish the drive home sequence to close out the mission.

guide.inShort: Finish the story mission Headliners. Expect a public, high-heat set-piece in Vice City, so plan your exit before it starts.

steps.text: Begin Headliners and complete the venue setup objectives in order.
When the escape starts, change vehicles once to drop your wanted level faster.
Reach the safehouse marker and let the mission wrap-up play.

guide.inShort: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Airside driving is open and fast, so use the runways to build distance.

steps.text: Infiltrate the airport perimeter following the mission markers.
Complete the takedown objective, then take the fastest airside vehicle available.
Leave the airport zone and lose the heat to finish the mission.

guide.inShort: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the longer combat missions, so resupply fully beforehand.

steps.text: Start the operation with full armour and a rifle with plenty of reserve ammo.
Advance objective by objective, clearing each area before moving on.
Survive the final stand and watch the extraction cutscene to the end.

guide.inShort: Reach 100 percent on the in-game completion checklist. The game tracks the categories for you, so work the checklist rather than guessing.

steps.text: Open the 100 percent checklist in the pause menu and clear story first, since it unlocks most categories.
Sweep collectibles and activities county by county, ticking categories off in the Ledger as you go.
When the checklist reads 100 percent, the Gold pops without any extra mission.

guide.inShort: Land 250 stunts in total. Ramp trucks, airport ramps and the Keys causeways all count, and repeats on the same ramp still register.

steps.text: Learn one reliable ramp line and repeat it, using the Ledger counter after each session.
Use a light sports bike for control; heavy vehicles fail more landings than they complete.
Mix stunt locations in during collectible sweeps so the count climbs without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

guide.inShort: Try all 9 activity types once. You only need to start each type, not master it, so knock this out in your first hours.

steps.text: Open the activities list and note the 9 types so nothing is missed.
Start one session of each type as its icon appears on the map.
After the ninth different type begins, the trophy registers immediately.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

guide.inShort: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Accuracy bonuses matter more than raw speed on most lanes.

steps.text: Clear each range once to learn target patterns before chasing gold scores.
Replay your worst lanes first and use the weapon each lane was tuned for.
Keep a streak of headshots to hold the multiplier that gold scores depend on.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

guide.inShort: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Winning once per location is enough; you do not need course records.

steps.text: Unlock drone race locations as you explore, and mark wins in the Ledger counter.
Learn each course with a slow sighting lap, then push only on the straights.
Cut inside on gates rather than swinging wide, which saves seconds per lap.

guide.inShort: Win 20 different races. They must be distinct events, so spread wins across the map instead of farming one course.

steps.text: Enter every new race icon you pass and log the win in the Ledger counter.
Bring a tuned car in its class; stock vehicles struggle in later races.
If a race keeps beating you, lower traffic density in settings and retry fresh.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

guide.inShort: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing unlocks early, and Cal's target weight is beatable with mid-tier bait at dawn.

steps.text: Meet Cal at a fishing spot and accept the challenge from the prompt.
Fish at dawn with the best bait you own, prioritising weight over variety.
Weigh in a heavier catch than Cal before the timer ends to take the win.

guide.inShort: Finish one arcade game from start to completion screen. Pick the shortest cabinet in any arcade or bar.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or arcade hall and start a game.
Play through to the game's own completion or credits screen, not just a high score.
Exit the cabinet normally so the completion is recorded.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger strands can stall if you rush the story; finish Andy's strand before the final chapter to be safe. Guides differ on whether it truly locks.

guide.inShort: Finish Andy's stranger strand, ending with his final mission. Do his missions as they appear rather than banking them all for the endgame.

steps.text: Meet Andy at his stranger marker and complete each strand mission in sequence.
Return after each cooldown call or text until the final mission unlocks.
Complete Andy's final mission to close the strand and pop the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Kenton's strand is tied to the Keys; clear it before the late-story point of no return. Sources disagree on a hard lock, so treat it as watch.

guide.inShort: Finish Kenton's stranger strand and its final mission. His missions involve boats, so keep a fast boat stored nearby.

steps.text: Start Kenton's strand at the marina marker and work through his missions in order.
Use your own stored boat for his timed legs to save the walk to a rental.
Complete the final mission for Kenton to finish the strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Billy's strand spans the rural north; finish it before the finale in case travel locks change. Community reports conflict, hence watch status.

guide.inShort: Finish Billy's stranger strand, ending with his final mission. His jobs are rural and vehicle-based, so bring something with ground clearance.

steps.text: Pick up Billy's stranger marker in the northern counties and start his chain.
Complete each follow-up as texts arrive, checking the journal between story missions.
Run Billy's final mission to completion to close the strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

guide.inShort: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. Individual strand trophies cover several of them, so this often pops alongside the last one.

steps.text: Track strand progress in the journal; a strand counts only when its final mission is done.
Prioritise strands tied to their own trophies first, then fill the rest with short strands.
Log each finished strand in the Ledger counter until it reaches 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Randy's delivery strand can be left late, but guides advise finishing before the endgame reshuffle. Flagged watch because reports conflict.

guide.inShort: Finish Randy's stranger strand and its final mission. His jobs are delivery runs, so a fast, durable car makes them trivial.

steps.text: Start Randy's strand from his depot marker and accept the first delivery.
Complete each delivery chain step, repairing your vehicle between runs.
Finish Randy's final mission to close out the strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Tyrone's strand sits in Vice City; complete it before the final missions change district access. Sources disagree, so it stays on watch.

guide.inShort: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand, ending with his final mission. Expect driving and light combat in dense city blocks.

steps.text: Meet Tyrone at his city marker and work through his strand missions in order.
Keep a compact car for his alley-heavy routes through Vice City.
Complete Tyrone's final mission to finish the strand and earn the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

guide.inShort: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots sit at scenic lookouts, so pair the sweep with area exploration.

steps.text: Reveal spots by exploring; each one is a marked mat or marker at a viewpoint.
Interact and stay for the full meditation animation so the spot registers.
Tick spots off in the Ledger counter county by county until you reach 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

guide.inShort: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Bring a scoped rifle and approach downwind in the marked hunting ground.

steps.text: Take Bret's hunting job and travel to the marked territory in the wilds.
Track prints and calls, crouching for the final approach to avoid spooking it.
Take the shot cleanly and confirm the kill to complete Bret's request.

guide.inShort: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered statewide, so finish the three smallest sets first.

steps.text: Check set sizes in the collectibles menu and target the three shortest sets.
Sweep cards region by region, logging each completed set in the Ledger.
Turn in the final card of your third set to pop the Silver.

guide.inShort: Use the WAiNK It interaction at 100 distinct locations. Locations are dense in Vice City, so a single city sweep covers much of the total.

steps.text: Trigger WAiNK It wherever the prompt appears and note that repeats at one spot do not count.
Work Vice City block by block, then mop up rural locations during other sweeps.
Keep the Ledger counter updated per session until it reaches 100.

guide.inShort: Complete any 50 challenges from the challenges menu. Short ambient challenges respawn, so variety is easy to find.

steps.text: Open the challenges list and favourite the shortest ones near your usual routes.
Complete challenges opportunistically while travelling between bigger objectives.
Log completions in the Ledger counter and push to 50 at your own pace.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

guide.inShort: Reach a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose it completely. Tunnels and rail lines break police sightlines fastest.

steps.text: Commit crimes with your partner present until the wanted level reaches 4 stars.
Drive into a tunnel or underpass and stay out of sight until the search phase starts.
Remain hidden until all stars clear while your partner is still with you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

guide.inShort: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping a wanted level the whole time. Pick a strip of shops on one street to minimise travel.

steps.text: Choose three shops close together and rob the first with your partner inside.
Move straight to the second and third shops without letting the wanted level expire.
After the third register is emptied, escape however you like; the trophy is already earned.

guide.inShort: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting in the driver's seat. Parking lots, marinas and the airport are the fastest variety spots.

steps.text: Enter every new vehicle model you see; discovery registers on entry, not ownership.
Sweep the airport lot, a marina and a beach lot for models that never spawn in traffic.
Track the count in the Ledger until your discovered total reaches 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

guide.inShort: Drop 5 enemies during one Combat Focus activation. Gang hideouts and the later story missions give you clustered targets.

steps.text: Find a spot with at least 5 enemies in one room or yard before activating Focus.
Pre-aim at head height and sweep targets left to right once Focus starts.
If you fall short, reload the encounter rather than hunting for a fresh group mid-mission.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: The departure appears tied to a story-era airport state; do it before the late story changes VCIA access. Two guides call it missable, one does not, so it is flagged possibly.

guide.inShort: Leave VCIA airport in an unscheduled way: take an aircraft or vehicle out without clearance. Easiest while airport access is still story-open.

steps.text: Enter the VCIA airfield and locate a usable plane or fast airside vehicle.
Depart without following the taxi or clearance prompts the game offers.
Clear the airport boundary in the air or at speed for the trophy to register.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: The description is deliberately vague and no guide fully agrees on the trigger; best current reading is surviving or escaping a Rhino tank encounter. Marked unconfirmed.

guide.inShort: Linked to Rhino tanks: provoke a maximum-heat response until Rhinos deploy, then survive the encounter. Treat guidance as best-effort until sources converge.

steps.text: Raise your wanted level to maximum in an open area where military vehicles can reach you.
Stay in the encounter once a Rhino arrives instead of fleeing immediately.
Destroy or escape the Rhino and survive to bank the trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

guide.inShort: Empty a jewelry store without a single detection. Go at night, masked, and leave through the back before alarms escalate.

steps.text: Scope a jewelry store and enter quietly outside peak hours with a mask on.
Loot display cases without threatening staff, which is what triggers detection.
Exit via the rear and leave the block on foot before checking the take.

guide.inShort: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Each vault needs its own approach, so plan an exit vehicle before you go in.

steps.text: Case a bank, park a getaway car in the nearest alley, then start the vault robbery.
Grab the vault cash and leave on your planned route instead of fighting at the door.
Log each clean escape in the Ledger counter until you reach 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

guide.inShort: Rob one armored truck and escape. Sticky explosives on the rear doors are the classic, fastest way in.

steps.text: Follow an armored truck until it stops or slows in a quiet street.
Blast the rear doors, grab the cash cases and get straight into your car.
Lose the wanted level to complete the escape requirement.

guide.inShort: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, and a slow scenic flight or drive clears most gaps.

steps.text: Check the map for fogged areas and plan routes that pass through each one.
Use a plane or helicopter for island and swamp pockets that roads skip.
Confirm the explored count in the Ledger as you close the last fogged areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

guide.inShort: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked by gang territory, so vary your targets rather than repeating one gang.

steps.text: Identify gang territories on the map and list one operation per gang.
Hit each operation, take the goods and leave before reinforcements stack up.
Tick gangs off in the Ledger counter until all 9 are covered.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

guide.inShort: Have a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and take in the view. It feels like a one-off story moment, but it stays available in free roam, so there is no rush.

steps.text: Head to the Ocean Beach strip and find a beachfront bar with outdoor seating.
Order a cocktail at the bar and take the seat facing the ocean.
Stay through the short view sequence until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

guide.inShort: Steal a car from a vehicle showroom by driving it straight through the showroom glass. Pick a fast car near the window line.

steps.text: Enter a vehicle showroom and get into a display car facing the windows.
Accelerate straight through the glass in one clean run without stopping.
Drive clear of the lot so the escape registers in classic style.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

guide.inShort: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley and complete the follow-through prompt. A short activity stop in Vice City.

steps.text: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and start a game at the desk.
Play your frames, using the follow-through timing the tutorial shows.
Finish the game at the alley for the trophy to register.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Vague description; current best reading is a partner activity milestone with broad appeal, but guides have not converged. Marked unconfirmed until they do.

guide.inShort: Believed to reward a standout shared feat with your partner. Until sources agree, bank partner activities broadly and watch for the pop.

steps.text: Do partner activities together, including races, robberies and escapes, rather than solo.
Push one shared activity to a standout result, such as a clean win or record time.
If it pops, note the exact trigger in your Ledger notes to help pin it down.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: PSN-side tracking reportedly counts choices toward 500, but in-game confirmation is unclear. Counted here as unconfirmed; normal play should reach it.

guide.inShort: Make choices throughout the game; tracking reportedly runs to 500. Dialogue picks, approach choices and free-roam decisions all appear to count.

steps.text: Choose actively in dialogues and mission approaches instead of letting timers default.
Vary free-roam decisions, such as helping or robbing, so choice events keep firing.
Track progress in the Ledger counter if you want visibility toward 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Reading: fail something, then succeed on the retry. If you clear everything first try for a long stretch, deliberate retries may be needed; two guides flag it possibly missable in practice.

guide.inShort: Succeed at something on your second attempt after failing it once. Races and challenges with instant retries are the cleanest setup.

steps.text: Pick a short race or challenge and deliberately fail or abandon the first attempt.
Immediately retry the same event and win it cleanly.
If it does not pop, repeat with a timed challenge, which tracks attempts most clearly.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A strange-event trophy with no agreed trigger location yet. Rural night locations are the leading theory; flagged unconfirmed.

guide.inShort: Witness something strange in Leonida. Explore rural areas at night and investigate odd lights or sounds until the event triggers.

steps.text: Spend nights in remote areas, especially swamps and the northern wilds, watching for odd events.
Approach strange lights or sounds instead of driving past them.
Stay for the full event sequence so the witness registers.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

guide.inShort: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Low speed and a crowded sidewalk make it a one-try trophy.

steps.text: Drive slowly past a busy sidewalk with your melee weapon ready.
Use the melee drive-by attack as you pass a pedestrian, keeping the car rolling.
Confirm the knockdown connects; a clean hit pops the trophy instantly.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

guide.inShort: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Robberies feed you marked bills, so run this alongside vault and shop jobs.

steps.text: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and check your launderable balance in the inventory.
Visit a laundering contact and hand over bills whenever you pass one.
Log laundered totals in the Ledger counter until they reach $250,000.

guide.inShort: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops. Vehicles, weapons and property-adjacent spending in shops all move the total.

steps.text: Buy weapons, armour and vehicle upgrades as you play rather than hoarding cash.
Make one or two big purchases, such as a high-end car, to close most of the gap.
Track cumulative spend in the Ledger counter until it passes $100,000.

guide.inShort: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Save this for the endgame when story income makes the full set affordable.

steps.text: Reveal garage listings by exploring each county and checking the property listings.
Buy garages as funds allow, cheapest first, and log each purchase in the Ledger.
Purchase the eighth and final garage to complete the set.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

guide.inShort: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Any vehicle you own or borrow can be registered at the app prompt.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app after acquiring a vehicle and choose register.
Register distinct vehicles as you discover them, pairing this with vehicle discovery runs.
Log registrations in the Ledger counter until you reach 10 vehicles.
